scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=plugin/dist/cli.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cordonRequire}from'node:module';const require=__cordonRequire(import.meta.url);" && echo '{ "type": "module" }' > plugin/dist/package.json && chmod +x plugin/dist/cli.js
